# SHARP Gaussian Stereo — Quick Guide

## 1. How It Works

SHARP (Sharp Monocular View Synthesis) uses a single input image to reconstruct a 3D scene represented by 3D Gaussian Splats.

This node runs SHARP inference and displays the resulting scene in an interactive viewer. You can rotate the view, adjust the perceived depth, and generate a stereoscopic image.

The `IMAGE` output returns either a side-by-side stereo pair or a single view, depending on whether **Enable Stereo Preview** is enabled.

You can connect this output to any standard ComfyUI image-saving or processing node.

## 2. Model Download

On the first run, if the model checkpoint is not found locally, it is automatically downloaded from the official Apple repository:

https://huggingface.co/apple/Sharp

The checkpoint is saved to:

`ComfyUI/models/sharp/sharp_2572gikvuh.pt`

The model is downloaded only once. Subsequent runs use the local copy.

## 3. Node Settings

- **Save to Output:** Save the generated PLY file to the ComfyUI output directory instead of temporary storage.
- **Focal Length (mm):** Set the virtual camera focal length (35mm full-frame equivalent). This is a persistent node parameter and can be used to adjust the perceived depth of the reconstructed scene.

## 4. Viewer Controls

**Mouse**
- **Left Mouse Button:** Rotate the view.
- **Right Mouse Button:** Pan the view.
- **Scroll Wheel:** Zoom in and out.

**Main Settings**
- **Enable Stereo Preview:** Enable or disable stereoscopic viewing.
- **Parallel / Toe-in:** Select the stereo projection method.
- **Cross-eyed / Parallel Slider:** Adjust the horizontal image separation. The slider allows you to set up the stereo pair for either cross-eyed or parallel viewing.

**Advanced Settings**
- **Swap Mouse Buttons:** Switch the mouse buttons used for rotation and panning.
- **Splat Size Scale:** Adjust the apparent size of Gaussian splats.
- **Background Color:** Choose the background color.
- **Perceived Depth Scale:** Adjust the apparent depth of the scene. Values below 1 reduce depth; values above 1 increase it.

**Viewer Buttons**
- **Save to Disk:** Save the current viewer image.
- **Copy to Clipboard:** Copy the current viewer image.
- **Reset View:** Restore the default camera position.

Viewer preferences are saved between runs, except for **Perceived Depth Scale**. SHARP estimates scene depth independently on every run, so saving this viewer adjustment would not provide consistent results across different images. Use **Focal Length (mm)** instead when you want a persistent way to control the perceived depth.

## 5. Model Limitations

- SHARP reconstructs a scene from a **single image**. It does not recover the complete real-world geometry of an object or environment.
- Areas not visible in the input image are inferred by the model and may contain inaccuracies or missing details.
- The reconstructed scene is best suited for relatively small viewpoint changes. Large camera movements can reveal distortions, gaps, or incomplete areas.
- Fine details, thin structures, reflective surfaces, and complex occlusions may not be reconstructed accurately.
- The result is a 3D Gaussian Splat scene, not a conventional 3D mesh.

**Tip:** Realistic images with clearly defined subjects and visible depth usually produce the best results.
